Main Switchboard Panel

The primary electrical distribution panel on board controlling power supply to all vital systems and equipment, designed and operated per class and SOLAS rules.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Main Switchboard Panel?

In this glossary, Main Switchboard Panel refers to: The primary electrical distribution panel on board controlling power supply to all vital systems and equipment, designed and operated per class and SOLAS rules.

How is Main Switchboard Panel used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Bridge to engine room, monitor main switchboard panel for overload alarms and ensure all breakers are set for departure."

Why does Main Switchboard Panel matter in maritime?

Main Switchboard Panel matters because it supports clear communication in Engineering contexts for Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as STCW, Marlins Test, ISF Watchkeeper, and GMDSS.

Who uses Main Switchboard Panel?

Main Switchboard Panel is mainly used by Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters.

What category does Main Switchboard Panel belong to?

In this glossary, Main Switchboard Panel is grouped under Engineering. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?
